candidate_evidence.quote: [RADIATION] Preoperative brain irradiation (single fraction): Dose and volume escalation of preoperative single-fraction radiotherapy.

After the single fraction of radiotherapy, patients will receive standard treatment. The standard treatment consists of resection of the tumor followed by (chemo)radiation (i.e. radiotherapy +/- daily temozolomide (75mg/m2) for 6 weeks (60Gy/30fr) or for 3 weeks (40Gy/15fr)).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients with a new radiological diagnosis of glioblastoma (GBM)

role_evidence.quote: The standard treatment consists of resection of the tumor followed by (chemo)radiation (i.e. radiotherapy +/- daily temozolomide (75mg/m2) for 6 weeks (60Gy/30fr) or for 3 weeks (40Gy/15fr)).
Intention to treat with surgical resection and postoperative adjuvant therapy as per current standard of care (Stupp regimen).

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; standard GBM chemotherapy given postoperatively as standard of care

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention; it is listed as standard postoperative treatment ('+/- temozolomide', Stupp regimen intended per eligibility). The only registered intervention is preoperative radiotherapy, so no pharmacological candidate. Gadolinium contrast for MRI mentioned only in eligibility; not listed (R9).
